newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Westpac cuts home loan rate by 0.5 pts.
newsitem.headline: Westpac cuts home loan rate by 0.5 pts.

text.p: Westpac Banking Corp said on Wednesday it has cut its First Option home loan by 0.5 percent to 6.19 percent in response to the latest cut in official cash rates by the Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA).

Westpac said the cut would be effective from Thursday for new customers, but existing customers would have to wait until September 8 for it on take effect. The First Option home loan is the bank's so-called "no-frills" home loan, the standard variable mortgage rate.
